rule_legacy: J18 before J43: side x side cells, side = round(15 km / cell_m); the whole site when the tile grid has fewer rows or columns than side
rule_default: clip (since J43): the J18 side x side window clipped to the tile grid, min(side, R) x min(side, C); identical to legacy on every tile with R >= side and C >= side
rule_alternative: physical: rows = round(15 km / cell height), cols = round(15 km / (dlon * 111.32 km * cos(lat))), each clipped to the tile grid; cell area stays cell_m^2 as in the default

default.sites_keyed_by_fallback_note: site on a narrow tile, old best_window_km2 == weighted_area_km2 (whole site) and the physical window holds less of it (the site does not fit)
default.sites_changing_key_elsewhere_note: tiles wide enough for the J18 window where the actual cell width or height gives another window size than 15 km / cell_m
